now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
now.text: After seizing Zephyr One and taking Mack hostage, Sarge embraces his true self, Pachakutiq, and Mack kills him with his own sword.
now.on_a_card_about_b: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director. Holds Sarge captive, becomes his hostage, then kills him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A man with Coulson's face. Mack finally kills him, using Sarge's own sword.

proposed.text: At the Temple of the Forgotten, Sarge, now fully Pachakutiq, overpowers Mack, until May tosses Mack the sword Sarge stabbed her with and Mack kills him with it.

changes.evidence: Two of the three events in this S6#13 stage happen earlier: Sarge seizes Zephyr One and takes Mack hostage in S6#9 'Collision Course (Part II)' (AoS609), and Sarge remembers he is Pachakutiq and turns on May in S6#12 'The Sign'. What happens between them in S6#13 'New Life' is the temple fight: Mack cannot beat Sarge, May tosses him Sarge's sword and he slays Sarge. The card lines can stay as they are.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10
now.text: Nathaniel Malick, whom Kora left Afterlife to follow, kills Jiaying.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Kora's mother, killed by Nathaniel Malick.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Jiaying's daughter, who turns against her for Nathaniel Malick.

proposed.text: Jiaying begs S.H.I.E.L.D. to bring Kora home from Afterlife, but Nathaniel Malick, the man Kora left to follow, kills her at the Lighthouse.

changes.evidence: Owner ruling: a stage says what happens between the two people, not what a third person does. The current text is only about Nathaniel killing Jiaying. In S7#10 'Stolen', Jiaying makes the team promise to bring her daughter back, asks Malick what he has done with Kora, and is then killed by Malick's quake at the Lighthouse.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#11
now.text: Nathaniel holds Simmons prisoner and climbs into her mind with a fusion machine to hunt for Fitz. He pushes so deep that he erases Fitz from her memory completely.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Fitz's wife, whose mind Nathaniel searches for Fitz.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Malick's son, who tears through Jemma's memories to find Fitz.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Gideon Malick's younger brother, who tears through Jemma's memories to find Fitz.

changes.evidence: The line on Simmons's card calls Nathaniel 'Malick's son'. To Simmons, 'Malick' means Gideon Malick (S3), and Nathaniel is Gideon's younger brother, not his son. He is Wilfred Malick's son, so as written the line reads as the wrong relation. Nathaniel searches her mind with the Cerebral Fusion Machine in S7#11 'Brand New Day'.
